steps.text: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
I am. Did you get home okay?
Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
Distracted?
A little
Did the missing sock ever turn up?
Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
I thought you'd appreciate the update
I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
I've finally sat down properly
You look comfortable
Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
About choosing for yourself?
Yes
At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
I wasn't
I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
That's what I wanted you to have
And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
That made a difference too
Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
How was he once you were actually on the date?
Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
I can imagine
I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
How did he take that?
He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
I'm glad you got past explaining it
Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
That's worth a second coffee by itself
Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
He kissed you first?
Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
I pushed him back a little
Were you okay?
Yes, he just caught me off guard
I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
That sounds like him
Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
Of course he found a way to make himself right
Exactly 😭
He kept teasing me about it
So I kissed him myself to shut him up
And because you wanted to?
Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
Did the shutting him up part work?
For the duration of the kiss
Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
He actually asked you that?
Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
And that stopped him?
Of course not
So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
For now?
Oh, don't you start
I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
I'm just appreciating my lead
And proving my point 😌
How did he take it?
He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
That sounds about right
I knew you'd recognize the behavior
You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
I'm glad you can tell me that
And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
Was it strange afterward?
Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
Romance is alive and well
You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
That makes sense
It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
I told you we went for a walk after the café
There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
That's where the book came from?
Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
That is exactly how you choose films
He said something very similar
It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
Not always the worst thing
No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
That sounds like a good way to get to know you
It felt that way
We held hands for part of the walk
And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
You wanted to?
Yes
We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
So I said what I actually wanted instead
And he wanted that too?
He did
It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
That's what matters to me
I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
Good. Because I am happy ❤️
And you? What was today actually like on your side?
I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
Were you worrying?
Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
I am still me
I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
And you? Was today what you expected?
I didn't know exactly what to expect
I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
That's quite an achievement
An enormous one
Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
That's what made me happy
You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
Did you like the photo together from the café?
I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
I know, you told me
And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
I particularly liked that part
Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
I prefer getting to talk properly now
Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
It feels different now I've actually had that
Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
Good. I want to see you
I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
I remember. I even made room on the sofa
For me or the pasta?
We can discuss priorities when you arrive
Wrong answer
For you. The pasta can have a chair
Much better
I missed sitting next to you today
You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
I intend to
Are you tired now?
A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
7 MINUTES LATER
Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
An organized woman
Briefly
This one is just for you before I put it down
I wish I was there
Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
Is that included in the visit?
You can't switch it off
I wasn't going to
Good night, handsome ❤️
Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
